component.name: Sleeve
component.summary: Music library, player and sync dashboard

description.p: Sleeve is a desktop music player and library manager for the music you own. No accounts and no telemetry: it uses the internet only when you ask.

ul.li: Library browser with genre folders and instant search
Playback with queue, shuffle, repeat, cover art and synced lyrics
Playlists of your own, liked songs and a Health page for songs that need attention, with a tag editor
An Identity page built from your own listening, and looks that follow the album cover and the seasons
Optional Discord status and the optional playlist-sync downloader
